glosses: Without feeling or desire to work; deprived of sensation.

examples.text: The blow to his head rendered him senseless; he didn’t awaken until he was in the ambulance.

glosses: Lacking meaning or purpose; without common sense.

examples.text: What a senseless waste of money.

examples.text: The school shooting was a senseless act of violence.

glosses: Good-for-nothing; not dependable.

examples.text: Bill never mows the lawn, takes out the trash or anything. He's useless, but I love him anyways.

glosses: Unable to do well at a particular task or thing. Useless is mildly insulting.

examples.text: My brother is useless at most computer games, but he is an awesome PS2 player.
